project: Installation of metal roofing sheets, insulation/sarking blanket, safety wire/horizontal lifeline, flashings, gutters and downpipes to an industrial warehouse at Unitas site, Rouse Hill NSW
scope_of_works: Roof packs (1.2-1.5 T per pack, sheet lengths 22-34 m) are crane-lifted from a semi-trailer at ground level using a 120T slewing crane operating from three designated setup positions per the approved roof load plan. Packs are distributed over precast roof panels at no more than 150 kg/m2 per pack. Workers access the roof via scissor lift through a gate in the perimeter guardrail system. Applicable HRCW: risk of a person falling more than 2 metres; movement of powered mobile plant (120T crane and scissor lift).
quick_scan_focus: crane lift and pack distribution controls
scissor lift roof access and transfer sequence
exclusion zone below active roof edge
